info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Payments Payments Charge-v4-spec
info.description: The Payment Processing API facilitates the initiation of payment charges for various transactions. This endpoint allows businesses to securely process payments by creating charge requests in real-time. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms, billing systems, and financial applications that require direct interaction with payment services. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance their applications with seamless payment capabilities, enabling efficient revenue collection and enhanced customer experiences.

post.summary: Charge a payment method for an amount.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to charge a specified payment method for a given amount. Ensure that the payment method is valid and has sufficient funds to complete the transaction.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a payment charge. It includes the necessary parameters for processing the payment and ensures that all required fields are provided to successfully complete the transaction.

CreatePaymentsPaymentsChargeRequest.title: Charge Payment Request Body

requestId.description: Unique identifier for the payment request.

referenceNumber.description: Reference number associated with the transaction.

customer.description: Information about the customer making the payment.

resource.description: Resource identifier associated with the payment.

priority.description: Priority level of the payment request.

currency.description: Currency code for the payment amount.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates if a notification is required upon completion of the payment.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the payment was requested.

channel.description: Channel through which the payment is being processed.

recordIndex.description: Index of the record for batching purposes.

CreatePaymentsPaymentsChargeRequest.description: This schema represents the request body structure for the charge payment operation.

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.
